EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Corran Foods Ltd (the Company) and Imogen Hale (the Executive).

3. Start and probation
3.1 Employment starts on 2 November 2026.
3.2 The first six (6) months are a probationary period.

5. Pay
5.1 The Executive's salary is GBP 95,000 a year, paid monthly.
5.2 The Executive may earn an annual bonus of up to 20% of salary at the board's discretion.

11. Notice
11.1 After probation, either party may end employment on three (3) months' written notice.

13. Restrictions
13.1 For six (6) months after employment ends, the Executive shall not solicit any customer of the Company.

documents.text:
# Transcript — Lease negotiation

Meeting M-215 · negotiation · transcribed verbatim; corrections are marked in the record.

Participants: Bob Iyer (attorney); Calder Freight Ltd (counterparty)

[14:00:05] Bob Iyer: Our client wants the break date moved to 31 March 2029.

[14:01:20] Calder Freight Ltd: We could agree to 2029 if the rent rises to GBP 96,000 from the break date.

[14:02:45] Bob Iyer: A rise to GBP 90,000 is the most our client will accept.

[14:04:10] Calder Freight Ltd: Then we need a deposit of three months' rent.

[14:05:30] Bob Iyer: I will take instructions and reply by Wednesday.

Between Heron Robotics Ltd and Calder Mining plc.
